title: Saucer as contractor-owned prototype with umbilicals
place_text: Cape Canaveral Air Force Station, Florida

tellings.quote: I believe it was probably owned by a defense contractor and was not part of the US Air Force inventory.

plain: A saucer-shaped craft Greg Rogers says he saw in a hangar at Cape Canaveral Air Force Station in Florida in 1992 was, he believes, a prototype owned by a private defense company, not by the Air Force. Rogers, a NASA doctor, saw it himself and describes it hooked up to cables and hoses. If he is right, such craft are being built and kept by companies, outside the military's own records.
